newsitem.title: HONG KONG: CCT places 200 mln shrs to Xinhua unit.
newsitem.headline: CCT places 200 mln shrs to Xinhua unit.

text.p: CCT Telecom Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it would place 200 million new shares, or 12.51 percent of the company's enlarged share capital, to China's Xinhua News Agency at HK$0.42 each.
The telecommunications equipment maker said it had agreed to place the new shares to two wholly-owned subsidiaries of Golden Tripod (Holdings) Ltd, a commercial arm of Xinhua.
Net proceeds of about HK$84 million from the placement would be used for investment and expansion of the company's business and new projects in China, CCT Telecom said.

With the participation of Golden Trippod, the company will be well positioned to have a strong foundation and foothold in the China market to capture more investment opportunitites, the statement said.
Trading in CCT Telecom shares which suspended on June 16, is due to resume on Wednesday. Its shares ended at HK$0.52 each on Friday.
